body.statement: Using \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{KL}}\) with the fixed thresholds and one joint multiplier decision rule in its construction, does the pass event \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{KL}}\) occur for at least one preregistered observable stratum of \(\mathscr D_{\mathrm{KL}}\)?
body.justification: The fixed familywise gate makes empirical usability, rather than symbolic identification alone, the unresolved kill test for the named six-period consumer.
body.gap: Kim and Lee report matching and cohort-time diagnostics but not a joint stopped-rank, HDK-residual, de-killing, frame-conditioning, cohort-support, gray-zone, and precision decision with preregistered thresholds.
body.consumer: A positive certificate would deliver the first directly usable hazard-lift analysis of Netflix adoption; universal rejection or gray-zone classification would honestly kill that application claim.

obligation.what_is_open: Whether any preregistered Kim-Lee observable stratum passes the joint empirical event.
obligation.obstruction: Neither panel-level data nor stratum moment vectors, multiplier realizations, and numerical fixed thresholds are present in the immutable core. The event depends on joint stopped-word frequencies and cannot be inferred from published cohort counts.
obligation.attempted: Checked the complete formal decision rule against the available frozen inputs and the supplied presolve evidence. The inputs suffice to define the computation but contain no empirical values on which to evaluate any gate.
obligation.partial_result: For any supplied stratum-level empirical moment vector, numerical thresholds, and panel multiplier draws, \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{KL}}\) is a finite, reproducible Boolean function of the lower and upper endpoints in \(\mathfrak H_{\mathrm{KL}}\).  The frozen core supplies neither the unit-level Kim--Lee panels nor the resulting moment vectors and numerical preregistration constants.  Published cohort totals alone do not determine the stopped-word moments \(F_R(w),F_A(w)\), the chart singular values, the HDK residual, or the influence covariance, so they cannot determine \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{KL}}\).
